decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the firm’s established infrared-heating offer, it likely benefits from sunk engineering and launch effort, so management would tend to keep it unless weak demand became unmistakable.
Because it had its own webpage and fits the core portfolio, the firm has made a visible commitment to it and is therefore likely to continue rather than admit a mistaken launch.
This product is close to the firm’s existing competence base and customer needs, so despite only limited visible promotion management would probably persist with it for longer.
A full product line with several models implies the highest investment and portfolio commitment, which strongly favors continuation under escalation of commitment.
As a standard variant presented on its own page, it appears central to the firm’s core offer and therefore unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.

Although it seems more weakly committed publicly and may overlap with other tube-heater models, it still sits inside the established business where management is inclined to give such launches more time.
